title: Sleeping Baby in Vintage Stroller, 1950s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot capturing a serene baby sleeping comfortably inside a chrome-framed stroller or bassinet outdoors in bright daylight. The stroller features a padded fabric lining and toy beads strung across the front bar. The scalloped deckle edge of the photo print is characteristic of family snapshot processing from the mid-1950s.
